messages:
praveen: Quick sync — I'm drafting the PRD for the new Usage Tiers + Metering acceptance checklist. Main asks: clear pricing semantics, metering units, UI for limits, and rollout path for existing customers.

mike: SGTM. Can we decide metering primitives first? my proposal: `generated_token`, `input_token`, `embedding_unit`. Billing buckets: per-1k generated tokens, per-1k input tokens, per-100 embeddings.

dina: For Private customers we should decouple billing from enforcement. They want configurable soft-limits and audit logs, but no invoicing. Make sure PRD calls this out.

sam-ux: UX needs: limits page with per-route breakdown, projected monthly cost slider, and an exportable CSV for finance. Also show inbound/outbound token split.

praveen: Good. Edge cases to capture in PRD: shared API keys (org vs app keys), retroactive credits for mis-metering, bursts (short-term spikes), and usage reconciliation windows.

mike: Implementation notes: meter on the edge-ingress to capture raw tokens before caching. Headers: `X-Usage-Tokens`, `X-Quota-Remaining`. Also emit events: `usage.recorded` with minimal payload. Example payload (for spec):

```
{"org_id":"org_123","api_key_id":"k_456","unit":"generated_token","units":1345,"timestamp":1670000000}
```

sam-ux: UX question: when a customer hits a soft-limit, show an in-app banner + email? customer success wants both + one-click upgrade flow.

dina: Agreement: soft-limit = warn + throttle at policy=none; hard-limit = 429 + block. We need an admin toggle per-tenant for soft/hard default.

praveen: Acceptance criteria draft (high level):
- All meter events emitted for hosted + dedicated with <=5s lag
- Billing math stable across sample workloads (unit tests + regression harness)
- Limits UI surfaces per-route + per-model breakdown and cost estimate
- Admin toggles available for soft vs hard enforcement for Dedicated/Private
- Migration plan for existing customers that maps old quota fields to new tiers

mike: Regarding pricing semantics: rounding rules? propose round-up to nearest unit (e.g., 1.1k -> 2k tokens billed) but we can offer "exact" billing for enterprise on contract. Add that to the PRD.

praveen: Good catch. Also: metering boundary for streaming responses — count tokens as emitted, not buffered. Document the race condition if connection drops mid-stream.

tara-prod: For launch criteria: must pass E2E with a top-10 customer sandbox, docs complete, migration script tested against snapshot, and billing smoke for invoices. No launch until these pass.

billing-bot: notice: Invoice simulator v2 deployed to staging — use `invoice-sim-staging.redwood` for smoke runs. :robot_face:

praveen: Action items:
- mike: write metering event spec + rounding semantics (due EOD Thu)
- sam-ux: mockups for limits page + upgrade flow (due Mon)
- dina: draft Dedicated/Private enforcement config options + migration notes (due Mon)
- tara-prod: coordinate sandbox with top-10 customer for E2E (due next Wed)

mike: quick question — how do we show credits/overages on the UI? show predicted invoice vs actual?

sam-ux: show predicted cost on dashboard and a separate invoice view for final amounts. Flag adjustments (credits) inline. Keep it simple.

praveen: OK. I'll fold this thread into the PRD doc and create a checklist section. If anyone has major objections to the metering units, call them out here. Otherwise I'll proceed. :white_check_mark:
